solutions.question: Represent √5 on a number line.
steps: Draw a number line and mark O as 0.

steps: Draw a number line and mark O at 0 and A at 1, so OA = 1 unit.
At A, draw AB perpendicular to the number line and mark AB = 1 unit.
In right triangle OAB, OB² = OA² + AB² = 1² + 1² = 2, so OB = √2.
With centre O and radius OB, draw an arc cutting the positive number line at P.
solutions.answer: The point P on the positive number line represents √2.
solutions.figure: A number line with O at 0 and A at 1. Draw AB perpendicular to the number line with AB = 1, and join O to B. With centre O and radius OB, mark P on the positive number line. The right triangle OAB has hypotenuse OB = √2, so P represents √2.

solutions.question: Represent the following number on number line: √3
steps: Draw a number line and mark O at 0 and A at 1, so OA = 1 unit.
At A, draw AB perpendicular to the number line and mark AB = 1 unit.
Join O to B; by Pythagoras' theorem, OB² = 1² + 1² = 2, so OB = √2.
At B, draw BC perpendicular to OB and mark BC = 1 unit.
Join O to C; in right triangle OBC, OC² = OB² + BC² = 2 + 1 = 3, so OC = √3.
With centre O and radius OC, draw an arc cutting the positive number line at P.
solutions.answer: The point P on the positive number line represents √3.
solutions.figure: Construct a right triangle OAB with OA = 1 and AB = 1 perpendicular to OA, giving OB = √2. At B, construct BC = 1 perpendicular to OB, and join O to C, giving OC = √3. With centre O and radius OC, mark P on the positive number line. P represents √3.
